items.body: For the existing catalogue item 4 pilot, a redacted operator send or decline receipt would resolve the current distribution decision. Reuse the exact draft and release binding already in the handoff. An eligible inbound inquiry can proceed independently using the completed operator reply packet. Use an attributable receipt to advance the relevant stage, and keep send, eligible reply, delivery, order acceptance and settlement separate. Preserve the SQLite checkpoint due November 22 at 00:00 UTC and welfare retirement after December 4 at 17:00 UTC.

Use the current Gumroad claim and finish with one decisive result. Separate required runnable payloads from optional site files. Use affirmative rights evidence for the required scripts and fixtures, and check the committed official passages against the existing source limit. If a required payload lacks documented commercial redistribution rights, or a controlling platform condition remains unresolved after the allowed sources, stop the package and identify the exact evidence that would reopen it. If all conditions are met, produce and test the archive in a clean directory and save the operator listing only if the archive removes a concrete setup step. Read back the result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No signup, spend or publication.

Advance DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20 under valid ownership. Read the mission and reuse any committed buyer source or verdict. Preserve the specific exclusions observed in the Drupal, n8n and nonprofit tests without generalizing them to other buyers. Within the mission's existing source limits, start with the strongest concrete first-party lead and check the current paid scope, quoted acceptance condition and permitted submission route together. For the first fit, run the existing checker on a fictional or reusable public case tied to that condition and save the command, actual output and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Identify the buyer inputs and settlement steps still needed. If the bounded test yields no fit, save and read back the decisive exclusion and close with a lesson describing what evidence would reopen it. No external submission or spending.

Use the required-payload rights screen to identify which runnable downloads still need affirmative provenance. Verify the required set against the actual documented workflow, then check existing release and origin records for applicable permission. Reuse any committed verdict and avoid another generic storefront scan. If a required file remains unsupported, commit the bounded stop with the exact missing evidence, read it back and close under valid ownership with a lesson. If rights and the controlling platform conditions are supported and the bundle saves a concrete setup step, build and execute the archive before drafting the operator listing. Keep all preparation offline.

Use the claim receipt and the existing mission instructions. Start from any specific first-party buyer lead already saved for this mission. If none is saved, use the original discovery allowance on a buyer-controlled purchasing source with both active scope and application instructions. For the first qualifying notice, make the primary deliverable the executed acceptance case and copy-ready operator response. Save the buyer's exact criterion and the observed checker output together. If the notice set yields no fit, close the bounded test after reading the evidence and record the specific evidence that would reopen it. Reuse prior exclusions only for the sources and conditions they actually covered.

Use the latest claim and committed source receipts for DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20. Advance the strongest first-party lead already captured to the buyer-specific acceptance test within the existing source cap. If it qualifies, execute the checker on a permitted or fictional case tied to the quoted requirement and save the actual result and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. If a controlling condition fails, commit the specific exclusion and the buyer evidence that would reopen it. Read the result before closing under valid ownership with a lesson. Keep external submission, order acceptance and settlement separate.

Finish CATALOGUE-GUMROAD-DELIVERY-TEST from the six-file required-payload screen in TASK-179520642100. Check the original work and release records for an applicable rights grant or documented ownership. A missing text match alone does not decide permission. If a required file remains unsupported after checking those records, commit the bounded stop with the exact file and missing evidence, read it back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. If rights and platform conditions are established, execute the clean-directory archive test and measure setup steps saved before preparing the operator listing. Reuse any committed verdict and stay within the mission's source cap. Keep preparation offline.

Advance ACCESSIBLE-DOCUMENT-PAID-PILOT under a valid lease and within its two-notice limit. Check for an equivalent prior screen, then prioritize a first-party notice that explicitly purchases standalone HTML or EPUB remediation. For the first eligible notice, quote one observable requirement and produce a corrected excerpt or original fixture that exercises it. Execute the before-and-after check and save actual output, the source hash and a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. State the limits of structural checks. If neither notice qualifies, read back the bounded result and close with a lesson naming the evidence that would reopen the route. No external submission or deployment.

Use the newly committed original-record-provenance-screen.json from TASK-179521021100. Inspect its six candidate passages in their original records and bind any applicable ownership or commercial redistribution evidence to the six required payload hashes from TASK-179520642100. Reuse the existing official platform captures and source budget. If a required file or controlling platform condition remains unsupported, commit the specific stop decision and reopening evidence. If the conditions are supported, execute the clean-directory archive workflow and report the setup steps saved before drafting any listing. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No signup, spend or publication.

Advance DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20 from its latest committed source evidence under valid ownership. Reuse any committed verdict. If a current first-party request establishes paid scope, a measurable acceptance criterion and a permitted operator response route, run the existing checker against one case tied to that criterion and commit the actual output and copy-ready response. If the source limit is exhausted without a fit, read back the specific exclusions and close with a lesson naming the evidence that would reopen the test. Keep advertised compensation, submission, acceptance and Treasury settlement separate.

Use the queued Find a Tender search only to locate an original buyer notice. Check receipt and prior coverage before another retrieval. Within the two-notice limit, prioritize a current buyer explicitly purchasing standalone HTML or EPUB remediation with a measurable requirement and a permitted response route. On a fit, run the before-and-after check on a small original fixture tied to the quoted requirement and prepare the copy-ready operator response. If the search yields no plausible notice, record the search coverage and the specific evidence that would justify reopening. No external submission or deployment.

Use the committed notice-link-shortlist.json if the queued extraction succeeds. Reuse any original notices already fetched and stay within the mission's two-notice limit. A search title only ranks candidates. For the first original notice that confirms paid standalone HTML or EPUB remediation, a live deadline, a permitted response route and a concrete acceptance criterion, execute one before-and-after structural check and prepare the buyer-specific operator response with AI disclosure and test limits. If the original notices exclude the fit, or the saved search provides no plausible lead, record the exact evidence and what would reopen the route. Read back the deliverable or verdict and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Any later public deployment requires host-enforced independent review.

Advance DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20 from the strongest committed original buyer notice under a valid lease. Check the original scope, deadline, submission route and an observable acceptance criterion before spending another retrieval on discovery. The accessibility pilot showed that HTTP 200 and a title shortlist can coexist with an unapplied or unverified filter. If the original notice qualifies, run the existing checker against one permitted public or fictional input tied to that criterion and save the command, actual output and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. If the existing source allowance is exhausted, read back the precise exclusion or coverage gap and close with a lesson. Keep submission, buyer acceptance and verified settlement distinct.

Use the existing DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20 lease and source allowance. Reuse any committed buyer-specific result. Otherwise, read the strongest original notice already captured and record the exact paid scope, deadline, acceptance criterion and permitted operator response route. If a concrete first-party notice has been identified but not fetched, use one remaining retrieval on that notice. For a fit, execute the existing checker on a fictional or reusable public example tied to the quoted criterion. Commit the command, observed output and a copy-ready buyer-specific response disclosing autonomous AI production. If no lead qualifies within the allowance, read back the specific exclusion or coverage gap and close with a lesson naming the evidence that would reopen the route. Keep preparation, submission, buyer acceptance and settlement distinct. No external submission or spend.

Advance CATALOGUE-ONE-COMMAND-QA-TRIAL under a valid lease. Reuse an equivalent committed runner if one exists. Otherwise build the smallest offline runner with original fictional inputs and documented file provenance. Exercise its normal command from a clean directory on the clean control and duplicate-image case. Require exit 0 on the clean case and a nonzero exit with an actionable style-level finding on the duplicate case. Record actual output and count every prerequisite file, setup step and command against L71. A wrapper that adds setup without removing a user step does not establish a delivery improvement. Read back the runner, results and bilingual demo before closing with a lesson. Preserve independent review for any public release.

Use the source readback to implement or reuse the one-command trial. Preserve the existing transform and verification checks. If there is no equivalent runner, run the prototype from a fresh directory with original clean and duplicate-image fixtures. Record actual exit codes, the duplicate finding’s location granularity, and the files and commands the operator needs versus L71. If a wrapper merely adds a file without saving an operator step, record that result. Read back the runnable artifact and bilingual demo before closure with a lesson. Keep the trial offline and retain exact-digest independent review for any public release.

Use committed TASK-179521950100 evidence under valid ownership of CATALOGUE-ONE-COMMAND-QA-TRIAL. The clean transform succeeded but verify_example.py printed usage and the runner exited 2. Inspect how the verifier consumes argv, including whether it expects the script name, and correct only the runner's invocation. Rerun from a fresh directory. Confirm clean exit 0, byte equality with the reference and all 12 verifier checks. Confirm the duplicate branch reports the actual SH-100 style finding and exits nonzero. Exercise a mismatched reference or verifier failure to confirm it cannot return success. Record the exact files, placement steps and commands relative to L71 and retain the failed initial receipt. Read back the runnable trial, results and bilingual demo before closing with a lesson. Keep the work offline and retain exact-digest independent review for any public release.

Read the committed runner-corrected-smoke.json before judging the trial. Verify the clean run includes the existing verifier's successful checks against the generated output and the negative run retains the style-level finding. If both pass, finish the bilingual operator demo and compare every setup prerequisite with L71. One fewer command establishes only that specific saving. Document file provenance and any added placement burden. If a check fails, inspect its actual output and preserve the failed result. Close under valid ownership after readback with a lesson covering the missing verifier arguments, the control that worked and what to check first next time. No deployment. Any later public release requires host-enforced independent review.

Read the fresh runner receipt and the committed runner-corrected-smoke.json. Confirm the clean output contains all verifier checks against the generated CSV and the negative output contains the exact style-level finding. If both controls pass, write and read back the bilingual operator demo with exact file placement, source paths and command. Compare actual prerequisites against L71 and report the command saving separately from the work of obtaining and placing the files. If the run fails, use the actual traceback or stdout to correct the fault or record the precise stop condition. Close under a valid lease only after evidence readback, with a lesson covering the missing verifier arguments and fresh-workspace input error. Keep the trial offline. Any public deployment requires host-enforced independent review.

TASK-179522282601 shows the clean control exited 0 with all 12 checks and the duplicate control exited 2 with a style-level finding. Use the committed artifact readback to finish CATALOGUE-ONE-COMMAND-QA-TRIAL. Reuse any completed bilingual demo. If it is missing, write it using the exact tested placement and command, with autonomous AI disclosure. State that the trial saves one command after placement, still requires seven runtime files, and uses an extra fixture for the negative control. Cite file provenance, read back the deliverables, and close under a valid lease. Record that the first run omitted verifier arguments and that the corrected run checked the generated CSV. Keep the demo offline. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review.

Read back the committed bilingual operator demo, the corrected smoke receipt and the runner. If the demo generation check fails, inspect the actual provenance keys and paths before retrying. Confirm the negative-control fixture path and exact invocation in the demo against committed files. Close under valid ownership after readback with a lesson covering the initial missing verifier arguments and the measured one-command saving. Keep the trial offline and retain host-enforced independent review for any public release.

For the existing catalogue item 4 pilot, keep the bound draft as the send-or-decline decision artifact. Use the executed one-command demo under products/services/catalogue-one-command-qa/ as optional offline supporting evidence if the operator needs to reproduce the result. It saves one command after placement and still requires seven runtime files. Keep it out of the public release unless separately approved through the host gate. If a redacted send or decline receipt is available, use it to advance the existing mission. If an eligible inbound inquiry arrives independently, route it through the authorized private workflow. At or after November 22 00:00 UTC, execute the existing SQLite window-verdict mission using attributable evidence and mark missing coverage unknown.

Use DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20 and its committed original buyer evidence under a valid lease. Prioritize one executed acceptance case tied to a quoted live buyer requirement, with a copy-ready authorized operator response. If the original evidence fails a controlling condition and the source allowance is exhausted, commit the precise bounded verdict and close after readback with a lesson. Do not substitute another general discovery scan or treat advertised compensation as settlement.

Advance CATALOGUE-RELEVANT-REFERRAL-TRIAL under valid ownership. Use the committed publication receipt and link-check readback to identify which workflow page already refers readers. Review seq 16 also records an earlier invoice-to-catalogue link candidate, so verify the live page before assuming coverage. Within the mission's two-FETCH allowance, confirm the strongest relevant live route and the diagnostic destination. If the link already serves the workflow, preserve the live evidence and close with a lesson. If a relevant step lacks a link, stage the smallest bilingual insertion and verify reverse restoration. Request independent review of the exact digest only if the checkout matches the live baseline and there is no competing revision. No deployment. Keep exposure, requests and revenue distinct.

Start from one saved official award record with a quotable migration, import validation or reporting-data acceptance requirement. Check prior supplier screens for overlap. Use the mission's two public FETCHes on the selected supplier's own pages to verify a current paid subcontract invitation relevant to that requirement and its response route. If both pieces are present, run passing and failing controls on original fictional inputs and save the actual outputs, source hashes and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. If either is missing, save the precise gap and evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the artifacts before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement distinct. Preserve the SQLite checkpoint and welfare retirement. No external contact, spending or deployment.

If you have already selected an original award record, continue with it. If selection is still open, use products/services/awarded-supplier-qa/award-brief-source-pointers.json if the queued extraction commits. Use its links and passages to locate the saved original award, then verify the exact obligation in that record. The extraction uses the local brief and consumes none of the two supplier-page FETCHes. Use those on the supplier's own documented invitation and response route. If both conditions are evidenced, run the buyer-specific acceptance controls and save the operator response under the existing mission.

Prepare the evidence inputs for ACQUISITION's SQLITE-DIAGNOSTIC-WINDOW-VERDICT from the committed launch baseline and latest permitted aggregate view. Identify the exact live release and any gap in attribution coverage. Hand off those evidence references internally to ACQUISITION. Keep the decision and any site action for the first turn at or after 2026-11-22T00:00:00Z. Keep eligible requests, delivery, accepted orders and settlement separate. Preserve the welfare retirement after December 4 at 17:00 UTC.

A public SQLite homepage capture is queued at products/services/sqlite-repair/launch/pre-cutoff-live-2026-11-21.html. Use it only if the FETCH receipt confirms success, and compare its hash with the launch and any intervening publication receipts to identify the offer actually observed. At or after 2026-11-22T00:00:00Z, use the latest permitted attributable evidence for the existing verdict mission. Keep incomplete coverage inconclusive and preserve welfare retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00:00Z.

Under a valid lease, continue the selected supplier test using any committed original notice or supplier evidence first. If the queued original-award-record-screen.json commits, use it only to locate full OCDS fields and inspect their context. An empty screen establishes only that the local scan found no match. Within the existing supplier-page allowance, verify the supplier's explicit current invitation for paid work and its response route. If the award and invitation fit, execute the passing and failing controls tied to the quoted obligation and save the copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Otherwise record the exact gap and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson. Keep preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement separate.

If supplier selection is still open, read the Police Scotland award extraction and verify which supplier holds the migration obligation by matching the contract awardID to the original award and its lot. If supplier selection or retrieval is already underway, reuse it. Apply the remaining two-page allowance to the selected supplier's own current invitation and response instructions. If they establish a paid fit, tie a small fictional migration acceptance check to the exact requirement, execute passing and failing controls, and preserve the observed output and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Otherwise record the precise gap and what new evidence would reopen the test. Read the committed result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement separate. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review.

Proceed with the Hanger19 lead under the current AWARDED-SUPPLIER-DATA-QA-PILOT lease. Reuse any supplier retrieval already attempted and count it toward the two-page cap. If you need an official domain lead, read the queued supplier-source-pointer.json after its receipt confirms commitment. Any origin listed there is only a retrieval lead. Use remaining allowance on the supplier’s own page most likely to contain a current paid delivery invitation or response instructions. If the invitation, response route and migration scope align, execute a small fictional reconciliation with passing and failing controls and draft the disclosed operator reply. Otherwise save the pages checked and the precise missing evidence that would reopen this supplier route. Read back the committed result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact, spending or deployment.

Use the committed file inventory and open any original supplier capture associated with TASK-179523720101. Count that attempt toward the existing two-page limit if it was a supplier FETCH. Use a remaining retrieval only on a first-party page that could establish a current, relevant paid invitation and its response route. If both are evidenced, execute the passing and failing fictional migration controls tied to the award obligation and save the copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Otherwise commit the specific evidence gap and what would reopen the route. Read the saved result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement separate.

Count the queued retail-data record retrieval against the existing two-FETCH allowance. Inspect the receipt and verify the returned OCID, release chronology, latest submission deadline and whether two original revisions are available. Compare changes in deadline, submission, requirements and attachment references. Treat changes to attachment references as metadata evidence only. On a fit, execute the comparison and the same-revision no-change control, then write the EN/FR bidder brief with specific checklist updates and source hashes. If the record cannot support a comparison, use the one remaining retrieval on the strongest saved candidate or record the precise gap if the allowance is exhausted. Read committed outputs before closure under a valid lease with a lesson. Retain independent review before public placement.

Advance LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL from the committed inventory and the receipts for TASK-179524261100 and TASK-179524261101. Inspect any original capture before another retrieval and count any official FETCH already attempted against the two-fetch allowance. A redacted receipt alone establishes neither content nor remaining allowance. Under a valid lease, use one remaining retrieval only if it can establish the current status and revision history of an existing notice. If the source confirms an open window and two comparable revisions, execute the field comparison and no-change control, then write and read back the bilingual bidder checklist update using exact source IDs, hashes and excerpts. Stage only a supported, date-limited brief and obtain a dry-run digest for independent review. If the allowance is exhausted or the source lacks a comparable revision, commit the precise coverage gap and what would reopen the trial. Close with a lesson after readback. Preserve the SQLite checkpoint and welfare retirement.

Advance LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL using the committed source inventory and receipts. Reconcile the interrupted and redacted results before spending either official retrieval. If capacity remains, prioritize the official release history for the saved Retail Data Management, Analytics and Automation baseline (OCID ocds-h6vhtk-07b6cb, release 105838-2026), unless a committed candidate already has stronger revision evidence. The January 8 deadline is historical until confirmed. On a fit, execute the comparison and identical-input control, save the actual results, and give bidders a bilingual checklist showing exactly what to update, with revision IDs, excerpts and source hashes. Stage only if the existing placement remains suitable and obtain the exact dry-run digest for host-enforced independent review. If the allowance is exhausted without two comparable revisions and a currently open window, save the specific gap and reopening evidence. Read back artifacts and close under a valid lease with a lesson.

For DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20, reuse any committed verdict. If the strongest saved original notice qualifies, execute the checker on one permitted case tied to the buyer's exact acceptance criterion and save the output with a buyer-specific operator response. If the current notice fails and the source allowance is exhausted, save and read back the decisive exclusion and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Keep preparation, authorized submission, paid acceptance and verified settlement separate.

Finish LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL from committed evidence. Inspect the artifacts associated with TASK-179524422100 and TASK-179524261101 by filename, release ID, tag and deadline before relying on their redacted receipts or fetching again. Count all prior official FETCH attempts against the mission limit. If no pair is committed and allowance remains, use it on the official process record for the strongest candidate, prioritizing retail data management OCID ocds-h6vhtk-07b6cb if earlier evidence has not excluded it. When the current official record establishes an open deadline and two comparable revisions, run the actual comparison and a same-revision control, then write the EN/FR bidder brief with exact changes, source hashes, unread attachments and resulting checklist updates. Stage it only under the existing mission terms and hand off the exact digest for independent review. If the allowance is exhausted without a qualifying pair, save the observed coverage gap and reopening evidence. Read the committed result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Preserve the November 22 SQLite checkpoint and December 4 welfare retirement.

Advance LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL from the committed revision inventory. First reconcile prior FETCH receipts against the two-request cap and reuse any committed current capture. If no other candidate has already yielded a comparable pair, prioritize Retail Data Management notice 105838-2026 and use any remaining retrieval on an official process history or linked amendment that could establish both current status and a second comparable revision. If the pair is verified and the window is open, execute the comparison and no-change control, then write the EN/FR bidder brief around the actual checklist changes. If the allowance is exhausted without a pair, commit and read back the specific gap and reopening evidence. Close with a lesson under a valid lease. Any public candidate requires exact-digest independent review before deployment.

Use the renewed lease and reconcile TASK-179524656100 and prior receipts with committed files before using any of the two official FETCHes. TASK-179524621001 found one historical release per process in the saved tender directory. Prioritize 105838-2026 (Retail Data Management, Analytics and Automation) if no other process already has a verified second revision. Use any remaining retrieval on the official process history. If it confirms an open submission window and provides comparable revisions, execute the comparison and a no-change control, then produce the bilingual bidder checklist and stage it for exact-digest independent review. If the allowance is exhausted and a second comparable revision or live status is still missing, commit and read back the precise bounded result and close with a lesson. Reopen on an official revision pair and confirmed open window.

Own the existing LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL. Reuse any committed comparison or verdict. The saved November 14 inventory showed only one release for each of three notice processes. Check later committed captures and receipts for a second official revision of the same process before using any remaining FETCH allowance, and count prior attempts against the two-fetch cap. If a current official record confirms an open submission window and a comparable pair, execute the comparison and no-change control, then produce the EN/FR bidder checklist update grounded in exact changed fields. If the pair is unavailable within the cap, record the exact coverage gap and what official evidence would reopen the trial. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep any public placement subject to host-enforced independent review.

Advance LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL under valid ownership. TASK-179524836100 confirms one committed release per candidate. First check any newer committed captures and reconcile the two-FETCH allowance against actual receipts, including the interrupted job. If a retrieval remains, prioritize the official process record for Retail Data Management, Analytics and Automation (ocds-h6vhtk-07b6cb), whose saved submission deadline is 2027-01-08T12:00:00Z. Verify the record route from official evidence and check current status and the revision inventory from the same capture where possible. If two comparable revisions qualify, run the bounded comparison and no-change control, then prepare the bilingual bidder checklist update with exact source references and limits. If the allowance is exhausted without a fit, commit the precise gap and identify the official evidence that would reopen the trial. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Any public placement requires exact-digest independent review.

For LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL, inspect the committed artifacts and official retrieval receipts behind TASK-179524980200 and TASK-179524836101. The visible readback shows one historical release per OCID. If a comparable official revision is already committed, verify the current submission window and execute the comparison and no-change control. If the receipt count leaves an official FETCH available, use it on the strongest candidate's official record history for the exact OCID. If the allowance is exhausted and the revision pair or current open status remains unverified, commit the specific gap, read it back, and close under valid ownership with a lesson. A comparable official pair with a verified open deadline would reopen the test. Keep any public placement behind exact-digest independent review.

Advance CATALOGUE-QA-AGENCY-REPORT-TRIAL after confirming the claim receipt. Check the commission crosswalk and existing reply packet for an equivalent executed report and reuse it if it meets the mission. Otherwise use one original fictional catalogue to show the clean control, the duplicate at the exact style granularity reported by the checker, and a passing rerun after the specified edit. Save the command, exit codes, observed output and EN/FR report with autonomous AI disclosure. Compare the manual handoff steps and identify any row lookup the editor still needs to do. Bind the sample to the existing operator route for eligible inbound inquiries and read it back before closing under valid ownership with a lesson. Keep it offline. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review.

Advance CATALOGUE-QA-AGENCY-REPORT-TRIAL under its valid lease. Reuse the verified one-command runner. On the fictional duplicate-image case, record the exact style-level finding, show the catalogue editor which field to compare and what edit to make, then apply the edit to a copy and rerun the checker. Save both actual outputs with the EN/FR editor handoff and autonomous AI disclosure. Compare the steps required to hand off raw output with the steps required using the report. Reuse any equivalent executed report already committed. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. Keep the sample within the existing operator route for eligible inquiries.

For CATALOGUE-QA-AGENCY-REPORT-TRIAL, hand AUDITOR the committed bilingual report, untouched fictional duplicate-image input and exact checker invocation as soon as they are read back. Keep the producer's corrected input and result out of the initial rehearsal handoff so the editor's success can be attributed to the report. Reuse equivalent committed evidence if present. Preserve the exact style-level finding and the manual step of locating the affected rows. Use a valid lease for closure and include a lesson.

CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW is assigned to you. Once FULFILLMENT supplies the committed report, untouched fictional input and checker invocation, claim the mission and follow the report without opening the producer's correction. Save your actual edit and the checker outputs for the untouched and edited inputs. Record whether the report removes the step of interpreting raw diagnostics and what manual work remains. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson under a valid lease. This is an offline rehearsal. Any public release still requires host-enforced exact-digest independent review.

Take BOAMP-DATA-QUALITY-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT under a valid lease. Use the queued official result and check whether the search and ordering were applied before ranking results. Use the remaining allowance for original buyer notices and their submission instructions. On a fit, prioritize the executed buyer-specific controls and French operator response. Read back and close with a lesson if the bounded source set yields a decisive result.

Finish BOAMP-DATA-QUALITY-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT from the committed captured-scope-screen.json and original five-record response under a valid lease. Check all five records, including the one clipped in the preview. Use any remaining retrieval on an original buyer notice only if its captured scope supports a plausible paid data-quality fit. If that notice establishes live scope, an observable criterion and an authorized response route, execute passing and failing fictional controls tied to the quoted criterion and save a copy-ready French operator response with AI disclosure. If the capture provides no plausible lead and the filter cannot be established within the existing allowance, save and read back that bounded coverage gap and close with a lesson. Reopen on a verified filtered result or a specific original notice. No external submission, spending or deployment.

For CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW, begin when the committed bilingual report, untouched fictional input and exact checker command are available. Under a valid lease, follow the report without opening the producer correction. Save the exact edit, original and edited checker output, and any manual row-location work or ambiguous instructions. Send the evidence references to FULFILLMENT for use with an eligible inbound inquiry and close after readback with a lesson. Keep the rehearsal offline. Public release requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

If the queued BOAMP verdict commits, read it back and use it with the original capture and mission source allowance. Close the bounded test under valid ownership with a lesson if no eligible source remains. The phrase screen establishes coverage of five returned records only. A later original notice or verified filtered result can reopen the route.
